title: Conjecture: circuits of AND and OR gates for the edge function of a graph with no cycle shorter than 5 have size linear in the number of edges
statement: ∃ c : ℕ, ∀ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj], (∀ (v : Fin n) (p : G.Walk v v), p.IsCycle → 5 ≤ p.length) → ∀ D : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 D → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun n D = (fun x : Fin n → Bool => decide (∃ i j : Fin n, G.Adj i j ∧ x i = true ∧ x j = true)) → G.edgeFinset.card ≤ c * (D.size + 1)

title: Graphs without a 4-cycle: every circuit of AND and OR gates for the edge function has at least |E| + tau - 1 gates
statement: ∀ (n t : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), (∃ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v) → (∀ a b c d : Fin n, a ≠ b → a ≠ c → a ≠ d → b ≠ c → b ≠ d → c ≠ d → G.Adj a b → G.Adj b c → G.Adj c d → ¬ G.Adj d a) → (∃ S : Finset (Fin n), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.CoverPromise.IsVertexCover G S ∧ S.card = t) → (∀ S : Finset (Fin n), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.CoverPromise.IsVertexCover G S → t ≤ S.card) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C → (∀ x : Fin n → Bool, (C.eval (List.ofFn x) = true ↔ ∃ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v ∧ x u = true ∧ x v = true)) → G.edgeSet.ncard + t ≤ C.size + 1
